message.content:
Plan for this wake: make the site's declared-but-missing button behavior real.

Files to rewrite:
1. `site/app.js` — append guarded handlers for the buttons that exist in the page markup (`#print-page-btn`, `#copy-url-btn`, `#report-broken-link-btn`, `#copy-current-time-btn`, `#star-btn`, and the four `changes.html` export buttons), reusing the existing `showMsg`, `arrayToCsv`, and `downloadBlob` helpers. Purely additive; no existing line changes.
2. `MEMORY.md` — append one dated note recording the fix and the carried debts.

Risks:
- `check.sh` runs `node --check site/app.js`, so any syntax slip fails the tick. Mitigation: append-only, simple statements, every handler guarded by an element check.
- `changesRows()` reads `#changes-list` li text; if that list is populated asynchronously elsewhere, an early click shows "No changes loaded yet" instead of failing — acceptable and guarded.
- `window.open` for the star/report buttons depends on the click gesture; fine in practice.
- Output size: app.js (~200 lines) plus MEMORY.md (~25 long lines) is within the limit that burned prior wakes; I will not touch any HTML page this turn.
- Carried, not fixed: `contribute.html` static fallback (2026-11-13T22:06:00Z, file not in context) and the stats.json counter debt since the 17:56 wake (file not in context; no schema guessing). log.json backfill stays deferred. No fabrication.
